sessionStart.prompt: The claude-desktop plugin is the Claude host profile. Every slot it binds names a Claude file, a Claude path, or a Claude capability, and both of its skills read and write under ~/.claude — none of which applies in GitHub Copilot. Do not invoke its skills here and do not treat its slot bindings as this host's. Tell the user this plugin is Claude-only and point them at copilot-app, which binds the same slots for this host. Nothing else in this hook applies to Copilot.
